messages:
jana (product): Thanks everyone — leaving a quick thread for follow-ups from today's all-hands on pricing/packaging/usage. Drop short clarifying Qs and we'll answer live.
alex (growth): Will free trial credits automatically convert to monthly billing once they hit 0?
sam (finance): Short answer: no auto-convert. Users get a prompt to add billing details; we don't silently charge.
alex (growth): Got it. Is there a grace window for small overages before we block calls?
michael (eng): We rate-limit by tier. For self-serve there's a soft-grace of ~5 minutes to let in-flight requests finish, then enforcement. Enterprise customers can request tailored grace policies.
evans (customer success): @michael can you confirm if the soft-grace also applies to Dedicated customers with committed capacity?
michael (eng): For Dedicated, committed capacity protects throughput; we still enforce per-API-route quotas for fairness during extreme spikes. No soft-charge window there, but we do auto-fallbacks to lower-cost model variants if configured.
sofia (cofounder): To add — for Dedicated customers we offer a "burst" add-on for short high-throughput windows (pre-committed or ad-hoc) with predictable pricing.
jana (product): Related Q: do unused monthly credits roll over?
sam (finance): No rollover by default. We keep billing simple: monthly buckets expire at month end. We do offer contract-level negotiated rollover for a few large accounts.
avex (typo correction): alex (growth): typo there ^^
alex (growth): hah thanks. Another Q: rate-limit headers in responses — are they per-model or per-account?
michael (eng): Headers are per-route and per-account. Example: `X-RateLimit-Remaining: 120` and `X-RateLimit-Route: /v1/generate` — we surface both to help clients adapt.
evans (customer success): Customers ask about credits for evaluation clusters (private). Are eval credits separate from hosted credits?
sam (finance): Eval credits are separate when issued by us for trials/POCs. If you self-host Private, our credits don't apply; contracts cover private deployments.
anjana (clarify): jana (product): For policy: are there exceptions for research teams inside the company who need sustained high throughput for internal experiments?
sofia (cofounder): Internal teams can request temporary quota increases via the growth/ops flow. We approve based on capacity impact and priority.
michael (eng): Ops-bot: `quota-update-request received` — please include expected qps and duration.
ops-bot: Request logged: #Q-3456, pinging eng-ops.
alex (growth): One last one — refunds? If a customer is charged because they forgot to turn off a job, do we have any leniency?
sam (finance): We review refunds case-by-case. For first-time genuine mistakes, we typically credit back some or all usage; repeated abuse is handled differently.
jana (product): Thanks all. If you asked a Q and didn't get an immediate answer, we'll add to the follow-up doc and ping you. :white_check_mark:
